title.narrative: Strengthened capacities of SFMK for agroecological transformation

description.narrative: The project aims at empowered and vibrant civil society to advance inclusive socio-economic development in rural communities and actively contribute to policy dialogue within the agriculture-focused green transition reform process at beneficiary, local, and national levels. There are 5 envisioned outcomes: i) Enhanced impact and long-term sustainability of the national network by integrating improved internal operational efficiency and service delivery with a reinforced external reputation, ii) Value chain transformation process in North Macedonia supported by influencing the legislative and market environment in agriculture, iii) Farmers successfully sell their products at a higher, fairer price due to direct sales and value chain optimization, iv) Environmental and Social Safeguarding System is established and implemented in practice, v) SFMK demonstrates awareness of gender equality and women empowerment and is actively advancing the knowledge base, evidence, and institutional capacity required to address gender in a structural and sustained manner.
